description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android Bluetooth Chat application. It manages UI interactions, including fragment setup, menu options for showing/hiding logs, and initializes logging mechanisms.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main launcher activity for the Bluetooth Chat app, managing UI fragments, menus, and logging setup.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and adds the BluetoothChatFragment if no saved state exists.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu resource into the menu.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Updates menu item visibility and titles based on current activity state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection, toggling the log display fragment accordingly.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the custom logging chain, including wrapping Android's Log, filtering messages, and linking to the log UI fragment.
